title: encrypt() always uses AES-128-CBC; algorithm not configurable
description: encrypt() hardcodes AES-128-CBC as the content encryption algorithm with no parameter to select AES-256-CBC or AES-256-GCM. The public API signature is encrypt(inner_mime: &[u8], recipients: &[Certificate]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, SmimeError>. Once callers depend on this signature, adding an algorithm parameter is a breaking change. RFC 5751 §2.7 recommends AES-256; many enterprise policies require it. This will generate issues asking for AES-256 support and the current API cannot accommodate it without a semver break.
close_reason: documented in encrypt() doc comment: AES-128-CBC with RSA/P-256, AES-256-CBC with P-384; configurable in future version
